oracle.name: Scholar of Stars
oracle.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control an artifact, draw a card.

oracle.name: Krosan Druid
oracle.oracle_text:
Kicker {4}{G} (You may pay an additional {4}{G} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, you gain 10 life.
oracle.flavor_text: "Druids endure disaster as seeds endure winter. Now Krosa blooms once more."

oracle.name: Garruk's Uprising
oracle.oracle_text:

Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.

oracle.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, if you control another Spirit, you gain 3 life.
oracle.flavor_text: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

oracle.name: Nantuko Shaman
oracle.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, if you control no tapped lands, draw a card.
Suspend 1—{2}{G}{G} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay {2}{G}{G} and exile it with a time counter on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. It has haste.)

oracle.name: Stormscape Battlemage
oracle.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} and/or {2}{B} (You may pay an additional {W} and/or {2}{B} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked with its {W} kicker, you gain 3 life.
When this creature enters, if it was kicked with its {2}{B} kicker, destroy target nonblack creature. That creature can't be regenerated.

oracle.name: Silkweaver Elite
oracle.oracle_text:
Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
Revolt — When this creature enters, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, draw a card.
oracle.flavor_text: Elvish weavers use spidersilk to make everything from tapestries to rappelling ropes.

oracle.name: Storm Fleet Spy
oracle.oracle_text: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.
oracle.flavor_text: "They're searching in the same direction we are. And for the same thing, I'll wager."

oracle.name: Saruli Gatekeepers
oracle.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control two or more Gates, you gain 7 life.
oracle.flavor_text: In Ravnica's wilder districts, nature still stirs, and its protectors still mind their posts.

oracle.name: Skyship Buccaneer
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying
Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.
oracle.flavor_text:
"It's a pirate's nature to be free of law. Gravity is no exception."
—Kari Zev, skyship captain

oracle.oracle_text:
When this land enters, if you control two or more Gates, you gain 3 life.
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any type that a Gate you control could produce.

oracle.name: Hollowhenge Scavenger
oracle.oracle_text: Morbid — When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, you gain 5 life.
oracle.flavor_text: After werewolves slaughtered the citizenry of Hollowhenge, other creatures moved in.

oracle.name: Lagonna-Band Elder
oracle.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control an enchantment, you gain 3 life.
oracle.flavor_text: "The best lessons are not the ones I teach. They are the ones the pupils realize for themselves."

oracle.name: Linvala, the Preserver
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying
When Linvala enters, if an opponent has more life than you, you gain 5 life.
When Linvala enters, if an opponent controls more creatures than you, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.

oracle.name: Clockwork Servant
oracle.oracle_text: Adamant — When this creature enters, if at least three mana of the same color was spent to cast it, draw a card.
oracle.flavor_text: Some are annoyed by the constant ticking as they clean the cobbles, but to the castle custodians, there's no sweeter sound.

Flying

When this creature enters, if its prowl cost was paid, draw a card.

oracle.name: Rhox Meditant
oracle.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control a green permanent, draw a card.

oracle.name: Resistance Squad

oracle.flavor_text:

—Olivia Voldaren

payload.comment: When Donatello enters the battlefield, his triggered ability will check to see if you control an artifact. If you don't, the ability won't trigger at all. If the ability does trigger, it will check again as it tries to resolve. If you no longer control any artifacts, the ability won't do anything.
